captions.title: Analytics
captions.line: Six pages, each answering one question. This one answers what the business did.

captions.title: What you transacted
captions.line: Every recorded deal in the window. The period is written under every figure on these pages.

captions.title: And what AV Homes kept
captions.line: What is left after every share. This number did not exist before, and it is usually the one worth watching.

captions.title: Whose property it was
captions.line: AV Homes earns far more on its own stock, so its own and everybody else's are priced separately.

captions.title: The two funds
captions.line: A share of every deal goes to a prize for the best seller and a fund for the community.

captions.title: Every deal, one by one
captions.line: Transactions lists what was recorded. Filter by whose property, sale or rent, and who closed it.

captions.title: Open one to see the split
captions.line: Who closed it and their rate, then each upline, then both funds, then what AV Homes kept.

captions.title: It adds back up to the sale
captions.line: The last line is the check. If the shares ever stopped adding up, you would see it here.
